title: "IDYear_2025-IDWeek_2"
author: "Tyler McCraney"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(doParallel)
library(tidyverse)
library(RODBC)
library(hms)
library(cumstats)

# import functions
source(file="S:\\MSJM\\NEW_DATABASE\\RST_ENTRY\\RBDDfun.R")

# set dates
beginIDDate <- 
  "2025-01-08"

endIDDate <- 
  "2025-01-14"

IDYear <- 
  2025

IDWeek <- 
  2

# import data from MS Access
# .path value below is default & doesn't need to be specified
accdb <- 
  ImportMsAccessDb(
    .beginIDDate=beginIDDate, 
    .endIDDate=endIDDate,
    .path="S:\\MSJM\\NEW_DATABASE\\DoubleEntry_Database_be.accdb")

# save query
saveRDS(accdb, file=paste0("S:\\MSJM\\Data_Archive\\Passage\\R\\CY", IDYear, "\\queries\\IDYear_", IDYear, "-IDWeek_", IDWeek, "-accdb.RDS"))

# save standalone data and SampleID tables
dat <- 
  accdb$df

glimpse(dat)

SampleID <- 
  accdb$SampleID

SampleID

# import trap efficiency generalized linear models
GlmData <- 
  read_csv(file="S:\\MSJM\\NEW_DATABASE\\RST_ENTRY\\Td44glm188.csv")

GlmData

# QC
# verify no compromised SampleID (should be zero)
filter(dat, !grepl(pattern="\\d{1,3}_\\d{2}", SampleID)) |> nrow()

# check to make sure there aren't any unusual RST deployments (e.g., Gate 5 West, Gate 5 East)
# output shows the number of observations (i.e., fish) recorded from each gate
table(dat$StationCode, useNA="ifany") |> rev()

# verify QA was done
# should only output "Finalized"
table(dat$QaDone, useNA="ifany")

# verify no missing Q_SID (missing indicated by "NA")
filter(dat, is.na(Q_SID)) |> 
  distinct(IDDate, SampleID, Q_SID) |> 
  arrange(IDDate) %>% 
  print(n=nrow(.))

# verify no missing Acre_feet (Xd; missing indicated by "NA", typically results
# from failure to tab through all fields in data entry form)
filter(dat, is.na(Acre_feet)) |> 
  distinct(IDDate, SampleID, Acre_feet) |> 
  arrange(IDDate) %>% 
  print(n=nrow(.))

# visually asses Acre_feet (Xd) to check for anomalies that may indicate data entry errors
distinct(dat, IDDate, SampleID, StationCode, Acre_feet, TrapSampleType, GearID) |> 
  right_join(y=SampleID) |> 
  complete(IDDate, StationCode) |> 
  arrange(IDDate) |> 
  filter(!is.na(StationCode)) |>
  mutate(StationCode=factor(StationCode) |> fct_rev()) |>
  ggplot(mapping=aes(x=IDDate, y=Acre_feet, color=GearID, shape=GearID)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks="day", minor_breaks=NULL) + 
  theme(axis.text.x.bottom=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(facets=vars(StationCode), ncol=1)

# Velocity
distinct(dat, IDDate, SampleID, StationCode, Velocity, TrapSampleType, GearID) |> 
  right_join(y=SampleID) |> 
  complete(IDDate, StationCode) |> 
  arrange(IDDate) |> 
  filter(!is.na(StationCode)) |>
  mutate(StationCode=factor(StationCode) |> fct_rev()) |>
  ggplot(mapping=aes(x=IDDate, y=Velocity, color=GearID, shape=GearID)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks="day", minor_breaks=NULL) + 
  theme(axis.text.x.bottom=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(facets=vars(StationCode), ncol=1)

# visualize # of traps fished per SampleID & TrapSampleType (e.g., SS)
distinct(dat, IDDate, SampleID, StationCode, SampleTime, TrapSampleType) |> 
  group_by(IDDate, SampleID, TrapSampleType) |> 
  summarise(TrapSamples=n()) |> 
  ggplot(mapping=aes(x=IDDate, y=TrapSamples, fill=TrapSampleType)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks="day", minor_breaks=NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=1:10) +
  theme(axis.text.x.bottom=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5))

# fry/smolt proportions
# unmarked "wild"
PropCdFrySmolt <- 
  estimatePropCdFrySmolt(.df=dat, .beginIDDate=beginIDDate, .endIDDate=endIDDate)

PropCdFrySmolt

# estimate daily passage w/ glm
# unmarked "wild"
Pd <- 
  estimatePdglm(
    .df=dat,
    .beginIDDate=beginIDDate, 
    .endIDDate=endIDDate, 
    .unmarked=TRUE, # default setting 
    .GlmData=GlmData,
    .bootModel="na", # don't change
    .return="Pd")

Pd

# effort per-trap (for plotting, etc.)
Qdi <- 
  estimatePdglm(
    .df=dat,
    .beginIDDate=beginIDDate, 
    .endIDDate=endIDDate, 
    .unmarked=TRUE, # default setting 
    .GlmData=GlmData,
    .bootModel="na", # don't change
    .return="Qdi")

Qdi

# create nested data frame to pass to WeeklyPhat
PhatByWeek <- 
  tibble(
    Pd=list(Pd), # daily passage results from estimatePdglm()
    IDYear=IDYear,
    IDWeek=IDWeek,
    MSTModel="Td44", # GLM Td44
    OrganismCode=c(rep("CHN", 4), "RBT"), 
    race=c("W", "S", "F", "L", "n/p")) 

PhatByWeek

# apply WeeklyPhat function to nested data frame
PhatByWeek <- 
  bind_cols(
    select(PhatByWeek, -Pd),
    unnest_wider(
      transmute(
        select(PhatByWeek, -MSTModel), 
        Phat=pmap(
          select(PhatByWeek, -MSTModel), 
          \(Pd, IDYear, IDWeek, OrganismCode, race) 
          WeeklyPhat(
            .Pd=Pd, 
            .SampleID=SampleID,
            .propFrySmolt=PropCdFrySmolt,
            .IDYear=IDYear, 
            .IDWeek=IDWeek, 
            .OrganismCode=OrganismCode, 
            .race=race))), 
      col=Phat))

PhatByWeek

# bootstrap CIs
cores <- 
  detectCores()

cl <- 
  makeCluster(round(cores/2))

registerDoParallel(cl)

t1 <- 
  Sys.time()

#WCS
WCS <- 
  foreach(icount(5000), .combine=bind_rows, .multicombine=TRUE) %dopar% 
  bootWeeklyPhatglm(
    .df=dat, 
    .SampleID=SampleID, 
    .propFrySmolt=PropCdFrySmolt, 
    .IDYear=IDYear,
    .IDWeek=IDWeek,
    .OrganismCode="CHN", 
    .race="W", 
    .GlmData=GlmData, 
    .bootModel="parametric")

WCS

saveRDS(object=WCS, file=paste0("S:\\MSJM\\Data_Archive\\Passage\\R\\CY", IDYear, "\\bootstraps\\WCS-IDYear_", IDYear, "-IDWeek_", IDWeek, "-Td44glm-parametricboots.RDS"))

#SCS
SCS <- 
  foreach(icount(5000), .combine=bind_rows, .multicombine=TRUE) %dopar% 
  bootWeeklyPhatglm(
    .df=dat, 
    .SampleID=SampleID, 
    .propFrySmolt=PropCdFrySmolt, 
    .IDYear=IDYear,
    .IDWeek=IDWeek,
    .OrganismCode="CHN", 
    .race="S", 
    .GlmData=GlmData, 
    .bootModel="parametric")

SCS

saveRDS(object=SCS, file=paste0("S:\\MSJM\\Data_Archive\\Passage\\R\\CY", IDYear, "\\bootstraps\\SCS-IDYear_", IDYear, "-IDWeek_", IDWeek, "-Td44glm-parametricboots.RDS"))

#FCS
FCS <- 
  foreach(icount(5000), .combine=bind_rows, .multicombine=TRUE) %dopar% 
  bootWeeklyPhatglm(
    .df=dat, 
    .SampleID=SampleID, 
    .propFrySmolt=PropCdFrySmolt, 
    .IDYear=IDYear,
    .IDWeek=IDWeek,
    .OrganismCode="CHN", 
    .race="F", 
    .GlmData=GlmData, 
    .bootModel="parametric")

FCS

saveRDS(object=FCS, file=paste0("S:\\MSJM\\Data_Archive\\Passage\\R\\CY", IDYear, "\\bootstraps\\FCS-IDYear_", IDYear, "-IDWeek_", IDWeek, "-Td44glm-parametricboots.RDS"))

#LCS
LCS <- 
  foreach(icount(5000), .combine=bind_rows, .multicombine=TRUE) %dopar% 
  bootWeeklyPhatglm(
    .df=dat, 
    .SampleID=SampleID, 
    .propFrySmolt=PropCdFrySmolt, 
    .IDYear=IDYear,
    .IDWeek=IDWeek,
    .OrganismCode="CHN", 
    .race="L", 
    .GlmData=GlmData, 
    .bootModel="parametric")

LCS

saveRDS(object=LCS, file=paste0("S:\\MSJM\\Data_Archive\\Passage\\R\\CY", IDYear, "\\bootstraps\\LCS-IDYear_", IDYear, "-IDWeek_", IDWeek, "-Td44glm-parametricboots.RDS"))

# RBT
RBT <- 
  foreach(icount(5000), .combine=bind_rows, .multicombine=TRUE) %dopar% 
  bootWeeklyPhatglm(
    .df=dat, 
    .SampleID=SampleID, 
    .propFrySmolt=PropCdFrySmolt, 
    .IDYear=IDYear,
    .IDWeek=IDWeek,
    .OrganismCode="RBT", 
    .race="n/p", 
    .GlmData=GlmData, 
    .bootModel="parametric")

RBT

saveRDS(object=RBT, file=paste0("S:\\MSJM\\Data_Archive\\Passage\\R\\CY", IDYear, "\\bootstraps\\RBT-IDYear_", IDYear, "-IDWeek_", IDWeek, "-Td44glm-parametricboots.RDS"))

stopCluster(cl)

Sys.time()-t1 # time to complete 5k bootstraps in parallel

# estimate 95% CIs
#### WCS
WCS <- 
  mutate(WCS, B=1:5000)

# assess number of bootstraps
WCS <- 
  mutate(
    WCS, 
    IDWeek=IDWeek,
    `Phat*cum2.5`=cumquant(`Phat*`, p=0.025) |> round(), 
    `Phat*cum97.5`=cumquant(`Phat*`, p=0.975) |> round(), 
    `Phat*cumwidth95`=`Phat*cum97.5`-`Phat*cum2.5`)

ggplot(WCS, aes(x=B, y=`Phat*cumwidth95`)) + 
  geom_step() + 
  labs(x="Bootstrap replicate", y="Width of 95% CI", title="Line should stabilize", tag="WCS") + 
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))

#
WCS_CIs <- 
  bind_rows(
    list(
      Td44=group_by(WCS, IDWeek) |>
        reframe(
          `Phat*`=quantile(`Phat*`, probs=c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=TRUE) |> round(), 
          `FryPhat*`=quantile(`FryPhat*`, probs=c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=TRUE) |> round(), 
          `SmoltPhat*`=quantile(`SmoltPhat*`, probs=c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=TRUE) |> round()) |>
        mutate(CI=c("2.5%", "97.5%"), IDYear=IDYear, OrganismCode="CHN", race="W") |>
        pivot_wider(names_from=CI, names_sep="", values_from=c(`Phat*`, `FryPhat*`, `SmoltPhat*`))),
    .id="MSTModel")

# visualize bootstrap distribution & 95% CIs
ggplot(WCS, aes(x=`Phat*`)) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(WCS_CIs$`Phat*2.5%`, WCS_CIs$`Phat*97.5%`), color="blue") +
  labs(
    x=expression(italic(hat(P))*`*`), 
    title="Bootstrap distribution should appear smooth & symmetric", 
    tag="WCS") + 
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))

  geom_histogram() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(SCS_CIs$`Phat*2.5%`, SCS_CIs$`Phat*97.5%`), color="blue") +
```
